parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-hybrid-cloud-server --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --mid b1bf3f544f30c1de0b72d9129000ccb --custom-name '节点名称' --operator aliyun --continents asiapacific --region-code beijing --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyHybridCloudServer --region cn-hangzhou --Operator aliyun --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --CustomName '节点名称' --RegionCode beijing --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --Mid b1bf3f544f30c1de0b72d9129000ccb --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Continents asiapacific
